title: Version savings estimate payload schema + make Console rendering backwards-compatible
creator: Chloe Martin
description:
## Context
Suggestions (beta) surfaces a savings estimate payload from suggestions-service to Console. We already have v1 of savings estimation (batching + caching) landing, but we need a **versioned** schema so we can evolve fields (confidence intervals, basis-of-estimate, avoid double-counting, etc.) without breaking older Console clients or dedicated/private deployments on slower release trains.

This ticket covers:
1) adding explicit schema versioning for the savings estimate payload (service + BFF contract), and
2) making Console UI rendering **backwards-compatible** (gracefully handle older versions / missing fields / future unknown fields).

Related docs/threads:
- ADR-0275: Savings estimation contract (required fields + versioning strategy)
- #eng-platform thread on schema versioning/back-compat for savings estimate fields
- Beta scope is read-only; correctness + explainability > velocity.

## Problem
Console currently assumes a single shape for `savings_estimate` and will error/blank the drawer if fields are missing or renamed. We also have near-term planned additions:
- explicit `confidence_interval` (low/med/high bounds)
- `basis_of_estimate` telemetry pointers (time window, sample size)
- `attribution` fields to prevent caching+batching double-counting

Without versioning, we’ll either:
- block changes to suggestions-service payload, or
- create brittle UI conditionals that are difficult to test.

## Goals
- Introduce a **single, explicit** version field for the savings estimate payload.
- Define minimal compatibility rules:
  - newer UI can render older payloads
  - UI ignores unknown fields and does not crash
  - service can add new fields in a backwards-compatible way for at least N versions
- Ensure detail drawer + list view can still render a useful estimate when some fields are absent (with clear copy like “Estimate unavailable” or “Insufficient telemetry”).

## Non-goals
- Changing the underlying savings model logic (handled in ENG-2403 / Applied ML validation).
- Implementing “apply suggestion” workflows (phase 2).

## Proposal (implementation notes)
### Service / contract
- Add `savings_estimate_schema_version` (string) at the savings-estimate object level (preferred) or at the suggestion payload level if that’s where we standardize.
  - Example values: `"1"`, `"1.1"` or `"2026-02-01"` (pick one standard; see decision needed below).
- Add a short `savings_estimate_schema_min_console_version` only if we find we truly need forward-gating; otherwise avoid.
- Document compatibility guarantees:
  - Version changes that only add optional fields are backwards-compatible.
  - Removing/renaming fields requires a major bump and must keep old fields for at least one deprecation window.

### Console (BFF + UI)
- Update BFF typing/validation to accept:
  - versioned payload
  - optional fields for future additions
- UI rendering rules:
  - if `schema_version` missing => treat as v1 (legacy)
  - if version unknown => attempt best-effort render with safe fallbacks (don’t hard-fail)
  - if savings values missing/NaN => show “Estimate unavailable” + display reason if provided
- Add snapshot tests for v1 and vNext payloads.

### Testing
- Contract tests (service payload examples) wired into Console CI to prevent accidental breaking changes.
- E2E smoke: suggestions list loads + drawer opens for:
  - v1 payload
  - payload with unknown new fields
  - payload missing optional fields

## Open questions / decisions needed
1) Version format: semver string (e.g., `"1.0"`) vs date-based (`"2026-02-01"`).
2) Location of version: inside `savings_estimate` vs top-level suggestion. (Leaning `savings_estimate.schema_version` so it can evolve independently from other suggestion fields.)
3) Do we need an explicit deprecation policy (e.g., Console supports last 2 minor versions) for Private deployments? If yes, write it down in the contract.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Suggestions-service returns a version field with every savings estimate payload.
- [ ] Console can render:
  - v1 payload
  - v1 payload missing optional fields
  - payload with additional unknown fields
  - payload with a newer version value (best-effort)
- [ ] No runtime exceptions in the detail drawer due to schema mismatches.
- [ ] Contract examples added to repo and referenced by engineering docs (ADR/README).

## Rollout
- Behind existing `suggestions_beta` feature flag.
- Deploy service first (additive). Then deploy Console.
- If issues: rollback Console to previous version should still work since service change is additive.
comments:
2026-01-23 — Chloe Martin (creator)
Created to unblock savings model iteration without breaking Console. Please align with ADR-0275 versioning strategy; we’ve already had near-misses with field renames during prototyping.

2026-01-29 — Felix Schneider (assignee)
Proposed approach: add `schema_version` inside `savings_estimate` as semver string. UI will default missing => "1.0". I’ll add zod schema with `.passthrough()` so unknown fields don’t fail validation. Will post example payloads for contract tests.

2026-02-03 — Logan Wright
+1 to explicit version. Please ensure `basis_of_estimate` references don’t include raw customer identifiers; keep to aggregated window + sample size + metric IDs. Also recommend adding a `telemetry_freshness_hours` field as optional for later (don’t block this ticket).

2026-02-07 — Marissa Cole
From product side: we need UI copy to clearly distinguish “estimate unavailable due to insufficient telemetry” vs “estimate temporarily unavailable due to error.” Please ensure the fallback states can show a reason code / message if present.

2026-02-10 — Jada Williams
Watch out for BFF strict validation. We had a similar issue on rollouts where unknown fields caused 500s at the BFF layer. Make sure both server + client validation are permissive for additive fields.

2026-02-14 — Felix Schneider
WIP: service payload updated locally with `savings_estimate.schema_version`. Console types updated; adding snapshot tests for v1 + v1-missing-optional + vNext-with-extra-fields. Remaining: wire contract examples into CI and get design sign-off on fallback copy strings.
